_comment: Acknowledged price-feed gaps. build.js stops the bake the first time it finds a held ticker with no bar on a date its exchange demonstrably traded, because the day boundary would then be anchored on the wrong bar and the Intraday and 1-Day cards would report a wrong split silently. Yahoo does not backfill these, so an unconditional stop would jam every later bake until the date aged out of the audit window; recording the gap here clears the latch. Acknowledge only after verifying the date against the intraday series (range=5d&interval=5m recovers the session), and say in the note what was found. Entries older than the audit window are inert but are kept as a record of how often the feed fails.
